text: Health anxiety for about six months. Whenever my heart did anything weird I'd panic. I couldn't eat mushrooms in food, even normal ones, for a long time. I felt very guilty towards my roommate and my parents. I avoided my roommate for a while, which was hard since we lived together. Then it slowly went away, and now we laugh about it, a bit nervously.
Danach hatte ich lange Zeit Angst in dunklen, engen Räumen und in Clubs. Ich habe mich nicht mehr getraut, feiern zu gehen.

For months I had intrusive images of my son dead. They came at random times, while giving him a bath, while watching him sleep. I'd suddenly see him blue and still, and I'd have to touch him to make sure he was breathing. I checked on him multiple times every night. I couldn't leave the kids with anyone, not even my sister, for over a year. My husband and I haven't gone away alone since.

I had a lot of anxiety, mostly about the kids' health. Every fever was a crisis. I took them to the doctor for things that didn't need a doctor.

The guilt was the worst part. I felt like a terrible mother. I kept thinking 'what if it had been something serious'. I became depressed for a while, I cried a lot and felt I didn't deserve my children.

It's been almost three years. The images are rare now. But I still feel a stab of shame when I think about it.
Some anxiety about drugs and my heart for a while. Learned to test everything.

In den Wochen nach der Sitzung ging es mir schlechter als vorher. Die Depression war tiefer, weil ich das Gefühl hatte, dass selbst die neueste Behandlung bei mir nicht funktioniert. Ich hatte das Bild des dunklen Schachts immer wieder vor Augen. Nach etwa drei Monaten wurde es langsam besser, und ich habe angefangen, den Moment mit der Hand der Begleiterin als etwas Wichtiges zu sehen. Ich habe verstanden, dass ich Nähe zulassen kann, selbst wenn alles dunkel ist.
Lot of shame and anxiety for a few months. The relationship ended because of that night.

I was diagnosed with a brief psychotic episode, and the doctors said it was most likely triggered by the high dose. The feeling that my partner was an impostor faded over about two weeks, but it left a crack in my trust in my own perception. For months I had moments of doubt about whether the people around me were real or replaced, especially when I was tired or stressed. I'd catch myself watching my partner's face for signs. I hated myself for it.

I developed a strong fear of going crazy. Any unusual thought or feeling would send me into a panic, and I'd ask her if I seemed normal. I stopped drinking and smoking weed completely because I was so afraid of altering my mind.

I had derealisation for several months, the world looked slightly fake, like a very good copy of itself.

Our relationship was very strained. She was hurt and frightened and didn't know if I'd ever look at her the same way again. We went to couples therapy. We're still together, but it took a long time to rebuild.

I also felt deep shame about having pushed for the 'heroic dose' and putting her through that. The cat is still my best friend.

Ich hatte monatelang Albträume von der Hütte und dem Schamanen. Ich habe mich schuldig gefühlt, weil ich nicht eingegriffen habe, und mich für meine Schwäche verachtet. Ich hatte Angst vor Männern in Machtpositionen und war in Gruppen sehr angespannt. Ich habe mich auch von meiner Freundin entfernt, weil wir unterschiedlich mit dem Erlebten umgegangen sind. Sie wollte nicht darüber reden.
Pretty much fine after a week.
For a few months I had a feeling of being rejected by something cosmic, it's hard to explain. A low mood and existential sadness. When I closed my eyes I sometimes saw the tunnel. It faded over time.
Angst vor Atemübungen und vor Hyperventilation. Ein paar Panikattacken danach.

I have been diagnosed with PTSD in Europe. My symptoms are many and they started immediately after the arrest.

I have flashbacks of the police station, especially of the bulb and of the slaps. Any knocking on a door can trigger it. In the asylum accommodation there was a lot of knocking, so it was very hard. Loud male voices trigger me. Uniforms of any kind, even bus drivers. When I see police in the street my whole body goes cold and I need to sit down.

I have nightmares most nights. In the nightmares the faces are animal faces, like they were during the LSD. Sometimes I wake up and see these faces for a few seconds in the dark room. I don't know if this is the LSD or the trauma.

I have strong anxiety about being found out, even though I live openly now. I still feel that someone is watching me and will report me. I check the lock many times every night.

I have severe depression, especially because of my family. My mother calls sometimes, my father not. I feel that I have lost my country, my language, my career. I was an engineer, now I am waiting for my papers and I cannot work.

I have a lot of guilt about the names I gave. I don't know what happened to those people. This guilt is constant.

Sometimes I feel that I am not real, that I am watching my life like a film. This is mostly when I am very stressed.

My relationship with my boyfriend has been very difficult because we are both traumatised and we trigger each other. But we are still together.
